ovv2017.name: Homicides commited in Venezuela in 2017: Total and by type of murders (homicides_venezuela_2017_1.xlsx)
ovv2017.publisher: Observatorio Venezolano de Violencia (OVV), from police administrative records; published on HDX by Laboratorio de Ciencias Sociales (LACSO)
ovv2017.licence: Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0) - as stated on the HDX dataset page
ovv2017.notes: HDX description: "The data was extracted from police administrative records and worked by OVV at the county level. The last three columns contain: (1) total murders, (2) homicides with intention, and (3) murders committed by police forces." Each column is kept as its own measure. Column sums: 21,627 total = 15,147 intentional + 6,480 by police forces (every row adds up). area_id = the file's County code. Not an official government publication: Venezuela's government has not published crime statistics since about 2015-2016; this is the observatory's compilation of leaked/administrative police records.

problems: Matching notes: BOLÍVAR / ANGOSTURA matched to geoBoundaries "Raúl Leoni" (no Raúl Leoni row in the source; the municipality was renamed Angostura); COJEDES / TINAQUILLO matched to geoBoundaries "Falcón" (Falcón municipality of Cojedes, seat Tinaquillo; no FALCÓN row for Cojedes in the source); VARGAS state / VARGAS municipality matched to geoBoundaries La Guaira state / "Vargas" (state renamed La Guaira in 2019). Other variant spellings matched by hand (e.g. TURISTICO DIEGO BAUTISTA URBANEJA = "Diego Bautista Urbanejo", PAMPAM = "Pampán", PANAMERICANO = geoBoundaries typo "Panamericanp"). 18 municipalities have no row in the source file. geoBoundaries ADM2 has no polygon for Aragua / Ocumare de la Costa de Oro.
